name: Fernando Mendoza
comparisonPlayer: Justin Herbert with better pocket poise
summary: 2025 Heisman winner and National Champion. Prototype pocket passer with elite accuracy — the clear QB1 and consensus No. 1 overall pick.
fitReason: QB-needy teams at the top of the draft. LV is the heavy favorite to take him at No. 1.

name: Jeremiyah Love
strengths: Receiving upside out of the backfield
risks: RB positional value at top of draft
comparisonPlayer: Bijan Robinson with more long speed
summary: Dynamic three-down back who broke Notre Dame's single-season TD record (21). Blue-chip talent — the rare RB worth a top-10 pick.
fitReason: Run-game-dependent offenses with aging or departing backs. NO and SEA both have RB listed as a top need.

name: Sonny Styles
risks: Still learning LB instincts vs run
summary: Hybrid LB/S with rare athletic profile. Modern NFL defenses will covet his ability to cover TEs and blitz.
fitReason: Teams that play sub packages heavily and value coverage linebackers. PHI and LAC both list LB as a top-2 need.

name: David Bailey
summary: Ultra-productive speed rusher who transferred from Stanford and dominated the Big 12. Day-one rotational pass-rusher with Pro Bowl upside.
fitReason: Teams that need a bendy, twitchy EDGE to pair with a power rusher. CLE and NYG both list EDGE as a top-3 need.

name: Arvell Reese
summary: High-upside edge with rare athleticism. OSU pass-rush pedigree and ideal frame — will win off length and bend at the next level.
fitReason: Teams with a power-rusher already in place who need a speed-bend complement. CHI and DET both need EDGE high.

name: Carnell Tate
summary: Expected first WR off the board. Refined X-receiver who wins with size, hands, and footwork. Plug-and-play WR1 at the next level.
fitReason: Teams pairing a young QB with a legit X-receiver. CLE, LV, and TEN all list WR as a top-3 need.

name: Rueben Bain Jr.
summary: Junkyard-dog pass rusher with a pro-ready body and motor. Will contribute immediately against both run and pass.
fitReason: 3-4 and hybrid fronts that want a strong-side EDGE who can set the edge and rush. TB lists EDGE as a top-2 need.

name: Mansoor Delane
summary: Top cornerback in the class all cycle. Shutdown man-coverage corner who will slot in as a CB1 immediately.
fitReason: Man-heavy defenses that need a true CB1. JAX, KC, and DEN all list CB as a top-2 need.

name: Caleb Downs
summary: Generational safety prospect. Plug-and-play single-high and box defender from Day 1, with rare processing speed.
fitReason: Two-high defenses that want a rangy center-fielder who can also play in the box. WAS and LAC both list S as a top-4 need.

name: Francis Mauigoa
summary: Mauled SEC defenders as Miami's RT. Plug-and-play right tackle with All-Pro ceiling.
fitReason: Teams with an established LT who need a dominant RT. JAX, NYJ, and MIN all list OL as their top need.

name: Olaivavega Ioane
summary: Best interior OL in the class. Will start Day 1 at left guard and be a 10-year starter.
fitReason: Teams with interior OL holes. NYJ and JAX list OL as their top need; CHI and MIA both need help inside.

name: Makai Lemon
summary: RB-built wideout who breaks tackles and creates after the catch. Gadget-plus upside as a primary slot.
fitReason: Offenses needing a YAC slot to pair with an X. BAL and GB list WR as top-2 needs.

name: Spencer Fano
risks: Best fit may be guard despite T experience
summary: Swiss-army-knife OL who could start at any of five spots. Probably best at G or C in the pros.
fitReason: Teams valuing interior versatility. DAL lists OL as top need; CIN's interior was the problem in 2025.

name: Kenyon Sadiq
summary: Best combine of any TE in the class. Will be a weekly mismatch as a move-Y or big-slot in a creative offense.
fitReason: Offenses that flex their TE out wide. Pairs well with mobile QBs and vertical passing games.

name: Eli Stowers

combineMeasurables.note: 45.5-inch vertical — elite athletic profile for TE

summary: Converted QB with the best receiving-TE résumé in the class. Won 2025 Mackey Award. Offensive coordinators will scheme him like a big WR.
fitReason: Pass-first offenses wanting a weaponized move-TE. GB and LAC both could use a receiving TE behind their current starter.

name: Jermod McCoy
strengths: Ball skills at the catch point
summary: Physical press corner who wins at the line. If medicals check out, a top-20 pick.
fitReason: Press-man defenses needing a boundary corner. DEN and KC list CB as a top-2 need.

name: Emmanuel McNeil-Warren
summary: 6'3" center-fielder with elite production. Will go higher than typical Group-of-5 safeties due to length.
fitReason: Two-high defenses that like long rangy safeties. WAS lists S as a top-4 need.

name: Dillon Thieneman
summary: Three-year starter who produced at Purdue and Oregon. Rangy, instinctive, ready to start.
fitReason: Teams needing a rangy FS. WAS and LAC both have S in their top-4 needs.

name: Omar Cooper Jr.
summary: Reliable possession X with red-zone juice. Benefited from Mendoza but has real traits.
fitReason: Offenses wanting a big-body red-zone target. BAL and GB list WR as a top-2 need.

name: Blake Miller
risks: Foot speed against elite speed rush
summary: Quietly one of the most consistent tackles in CFB. Plug-and-play RT for a decade.
fitReason: Teams with RT needs. JAX, NYJ, MIN all list OL as top need.

name: Monroe Freeling
summary: Best LT prospect in the class. Pro-ready pass protector with upside as a run blocker.
fitReason: Teams needing an actual LT. JAX and NYJ's OL remain their top needs.

name: Jordyn Tyson
summary: Explosive, smooth route-runner. Could go as high as top-10 to a WR-needy team like KC.
fitReason: KC has been projected to take him at 9 in multiple mocks; WR-needy contenders all fit.

name: Kadyn Proctor
summary: Enormous LT with rare movement skills. Ceiling is a Hall of Famer; floor is an inconsistent starter.
fitReason: Teams willing to bet on rare physical traits at LT. JAX, NYJ, NYG all need LT help.

name: Akheem Mesidor
summary: Polished, productive edge. Ready-made rotational starter from Day 1.
fitReason: Teams that want a scheme-versatile EDGE in the first two rounds.

name: T.J. Parker
summary: Physical edge who can bump inside on sub downs. Ideal fit for multiple fronts.
fitReason: Multiple-front defenses that value inside/outside versatility.

name: Colton Hood
summary: Feisty cover corner with true boundary or slot versatility.
fitReason: Man-heavy defenses with CB needs. KC and DEN both list CB as top-2 need.

name: Caleb Lomu
summary: Technically sound LT prospect. Will start by Year 2.
fitReason: Teams with a medium-term LT plan who can develop him.

name: Denzel Boston
summary: Prototype X-receiver. Wins 50/50 balls and the red zone.
fitReason: Offenses needing an outside X who wins contested. BAL and GB both list WR top-2.

name: Cashius Howell
summary: Sub-package speed rusher with true rush skills. Will grow into a full-time starter.
fitReason: Teams that want a designated pass-rush specialist.

name: KC Concepcion
summary: Burst-first WR with return value. Needs to clean up hands.
fitReason: Offenses that can scheme him touches in the slot and on jet sweeps.

name: CJ Allen
summary: Smart, productive Georgia LB. Three-down starter on Day 1.
fitReason: Teams with LB needs (PHI, CIN, NYJ all have LB in top-4).

name: Keldric Faulk
summary: Big-body strong-side EDGE who can slide to 5-tech. Ideal for odd fronts.
fitReason: 3-4/hybrid fronts needing a base EDGE. TB, CHI, LAR all need EDGE/DL.

name: Anthony Hill Jr.
summary: Twitchy, size-speed LB who profiles as a three-down MIKE or WILL.
fitReason: Modern LB-needy defenses. PHI and WAS both list LB top-2.

name: Kayden McDonald
summary: Nose-tackle anchor with first-round buzz. Locks down the A-gap.
fitReason: Teams needing a real run-stuffer. WAS and LAR both list DL top-2.

name: Avieon Terrell
summary: Nickel-specialist with family pedigree. Starting slot corner early.
fitReason: Teams needing a true nickel. KC and DEN list CB top-2.

name: Max Iheanachor
risks: Raw — only played football a few years
summary: Huge swing pick for a team that can redshirt him. Could be a franchise LT.
fitReason: Teams with established starter who can develop him. JAX and NYJ top-OL-need.

name: Christen Miller
strengths: Powerful hands and lateral quickness at 320 lbs
Elite pad level and leverage when engaged
Georgia DL pedigree (behind Davis, Wyatt, Carter)
risks: Could use 10+ lbs of added muscle for NFL power
summary: High-tools, low-production Georgia DT who tests well and flashes dominant reps. Kiper has him #28 to Houston — a bet on traits and coaching over college box-score.
fitReason: Teams that need interior D-line and run-stopping presence. HOU lists DL as a top-3 need; Kiper mocks him to Houston at #28.

name: Lee Hunter
summary: Plug-and-play base DT. Not a pass-rusher but shuts down the run.
fitReason: Teams needing a nose/base DT. WAS lists DL top need.

name: Peter Woods
summary: Interior disruptor with pass-rush juice. Top-of-rotation 3-tech from Day 1.
fitReason: Teams needing a penetrating 3-tech. WAS, DET, HOU all have DL top-need.

name: Ty Simpson
risks: Limited arm strength on vertical throws
summary: QB2 in the class. A team may trade back into Round 1 for him. Accurate developmental starter.
fitReason: QB-needy teams in Day 2 range. Mocks suggest a team trades up for him late R1.

name: Jadarian Price
summary: Well-rounded RB2/complementary back. Will carve out a rotational role quickly.
fitReason: Teams needing a rotational/complementary RB. SEA, NO, LAR all have RB as top need.

name: Nicholas Singleton

combineMeasurables.note: Did not test — Jones fracture suffered at Senior Bowl

strengths: PSU career TD record (broke Saquon's mark)
Reliable in pass pro and as receiver
risks: Straight-line runner; limited wiggle in phone booth
Foot injury dropped him from Day 2 to Day 3
summary: Four-year Penn State producer with breakaway speed. Foot injury cratered his stock — now a Day 3 value for a team that can wait on him.
fitReason: Teams with aging or departing lead backs who can add a long-term rotational piece at a discount.

name: Chris Johnson
summary: Long, physical outside CB from a smaller school. Has tools to start.
fitReason: Teams that value length at the CB spot. KC, DEN, MIN all CB-needy.

name: Jacob Rodriguez
summary: High-floor starting LB. Instincts-first player who finds the ball.
fitReason: LB-needy defenses. PHI, NYJ, CIN all list LB top-2 or top-3.

name: Caleb Banks
summary: High-upside 3-tech if medicals check out. Traits are first-round caliber.
fitReason: Teams that want an interior disruptor to pair with an established NT.

name: Brandon Cisse
risks: Grabby at the top of routes
summary: Scheme-versatile CB2 with starter upside. Wins with speed and closing burst.
fitReason: Man-heavy defenses. KC, DEN both list CB top-2.

name: Keionte Scott
summary: Prototype nickel DB who fits modern sub-package defenses.
fitReason: Teams that run a nickel-heavy base (which is most of the NFL).

name: Zion Young
summary: Big-body strong-side EDGE. Sets the edge and collapses the pocket with power.
fitReason: Odd-front teams needing a strong-side EDGE.

name: Malachi Lawrence
summary: Toolsy, developmental EDGE with Pro Bowl ceiling if coached up.
fitReason: Teams that can redshirt a toolsy EDGE behind a starter.

name: Keylan Rutledge
summary: Tone-setter guard. Plug-and-play starter at LG or RG.
fitReason: Teams needing interior OL help. DAL, JAX, NYJ all OL-first needs.

name: Antonio Williams
summary: Pure slot with starter upside. Finds holes in zones and wins on option routes.
fitReason: Offenses needing a true separation slot.

name: R Mason Thomas
summary: High-motor rotational EDGE who creates turnovers. Future starter with polish.
fitReason: Teams looking for a depth-to-starter EDGE with scheme versatility.

name: Germie Bernard
summary: Versatile Z-receiver who wins with YAC. Day-one contributor as a 2/3 WR.
fitReason: Offenses wanting a balanced Z who can move the chains.
